title: CactiPVP
description: An addon for cactus mod that adds some pvp modules
body:
This is cactiPvP, a pvp addon for cactus mod and also my first mod ever
Yay

the version 26.1 of the mod will not be supported as ill stay on 1.21.11

## IMPLEMENTED FEATURES:
- Low shield, lets you add offset to the shield
- Particle Control: lets you show none, less or more particles, and also turn soem off and on
- Low fire, lets you change the height of the fire on your screen from just not showing to covering the entire screen
- Custom Hitboxes, they change color in certain situations
